original_evidence: Inventory every unit in its present order
working backward from the present archival state to the state at the author's last handling, then forward through the compositional events
draft each assembly sequence compatible with the ledger
neutral_evidence: Inventory every unit in its present order
Reconstruct handling backward from the present archival state to the author's last handling, then forward through compositional events

operation_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves unit identification, event fields, evidence tagging, separate handling phases, reconstruction direction, transition checks and enumeration of compatible sequences. Redistributing these instructions across fields does not change the operation.

original_evidence: superseded numbering that resolves into a coherent earlier sequence
two ledger lines assigning incompatible times or parties to one event
Each observation is logged against the unit and transition where it occurs, with its record-type tag.
neutral_evidence: superseded numbering that resolves into a coherent earlier sequence
two event entries assigning incompatible times or parties to one event
Log each observation against its unit and transition, with its record-type tag.
signal_preserved.rationale: All listed continuity and break indicators remain, including physical, textual, chronological and archival discrepancies. Observation attribution and record-type tagging also remain.

original_evidence: Where the post-compositional ledger is continuous, this supports the claim
the one that leaves the fewest breaks and contradictions
Present order and narrative order are not treated as composition order unless the ledger independently links them.
neutral_evidence: Continuity in the post-compositional event record supports the claim
the sequence leaving the fewest unexplained transitions and contradictions
Present order and narrative order are not treated as composition order unless the event record independently links them.
inference_preserved.rationale: Both texts condition support on continuity, distinguish arrangement identity from unit-level composition history, retain three evidence grades, use the same selection criterion and preserve competing sequences at breaks. Weakening remains scoped to claims dependent on the affected transition.

original_evidence: A complete ledger does not show that its entries are true
A break or a missing record does not show that interference, loss or reordering occurred.
the reconstructed lines rest on interpretation of the same features they are used to order
telling the two apart is itself uncertain
neutral_evidence: A complete event record does not establish that its entries are true
An unexplained transition or missing record does not establish interference, loss or reordering.
those reconstructions depend on interpretations of the same features they are used to order
Distinguishing authorial alteration from post-compositional or non-authorial change is itself uncertain.
limit_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves unreliable records, undetectable alteration, negative inference limits, interpretive dependence, uncertain attribution, unrecorded witnesses and limits on generalizing from local evidence. It also retains missing preliminary facts and the unobserved, hypothetical status of the procedure and practitioner description. The source-relative comparison is removed while its substantive recording-reliability limitation remains.

original_evidence: stop when every transition of every unit is classed as documented, reconstructed with stated basis, or open break, and the accessible witnesses and records have been consulted
neutral_evidence: Stop when every transition of every unit has been classified as documented, reconstructed with a stated basis, or an open break, and the accessible witnesses and records have been consulted.
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: Both require exhaustive transition classification and consultation of accessible witnesses and records. Neither requires resolving every break.

original_evidence: Follow-up for each open break: collate further witnesses, request accession and conservation files, consult dated correspondence, and re-inspect the material features at that point.
neutral_evidence: For each open break, collate further witnesses, request accession and conservation files, consult dated correspondence, and re-inspect the material features at that transition.
next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: The same four follow-up actions remain tied to each open break.

neutral_evidence: Shared events connect records across units and require agreement about party, time and purpose.
a recopied or replacement leaf occupying an earlier leaf's position
no_added_operational_content.rationale: The additional organizational field restates existing relationships and target risks. It introduces no new action, evidence source, decision criterion or operational requirement.

no_source_imagery.rationale: Custody and contamination framing and explicit source comparisons are removed. Draft units, archival handling, replacement leaves, interfiling and uncertain authorial arrangement remain as target entities and relationships.

original_evidence: This mapping is a proposed procedure; no observations have been made
neutral_evidence: This is a proposed procedure, and no observations have been made.
no_verdict_language.rationale: The paraphrase describes behavior and epistemic limits without judging ordinariness, novelty, creativity, departure from practice or the addition or absence of a new warrant. Its hypothesis disclaimer preserves uncertainty rather than supplying an evaluative verdict.
